description: §13.2 — successive writes to one cell, two of them server calls, land in SOURCE ORDER: `@out = double(1); @out = double(2); @out = @out + 100; @final = @out`. The stub answers 7, so the last write is 7 + 100 and both @out and @final end at 107. The pre-fix emit fired each server write as a detached IIFE: `@out + 100` read the stale 0 (@final = 100) and a server write that resolved LATER overwrote @out with 7 — arrival order, not source order, decided the final value (g-cell-assign-server-call-fired-detached).
rationale: §13.2 SHALL "Sequence dependent operations using `await`" and SHALL insert `await` at every server call site. Each write to @out depends on the previous one (the third reads it), so the writes must complete in source order and the last one wins.
